pause_conditions: provider rejects a request because of quota, credit, authentication, or rate limit
request identity or append-only trace integrity cannot be established
the configured model identity differs from the frozen matrix identity
non_pause_conditions: a worst-case full-plan cost projection exceeds a historical balance estimate
the historical CNY 27 or CNY 30 project threshold is approached
the observed cache-hit ratio differs from the preflight estimate
active_v5_note: The v5 canary was executed under policy v2. Its measured cost is far below the historical threshold.
